title: equisetum kansanum f. caespiticum
intro: Equisetum kansanum f. caespiticum, commonly known as Japanese horsetail, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the class Equisetopsida. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Japanese horsetail include diuretic, expectorant, and anti-hypertensive effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. These bioactive compounds are also responsible for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities, making Japanese horsetail a valuable plant for traditional medicine.
